# proxmox_node_firewall_options (Data Source)

Reads the firewall options of one node from `/nodes/{node}/firewall/options`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_firewall_options" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `enable` (Boolean)
- `log_level_in` (String)
- `log_level_out` (String)
- `ndp` (Boolean)
- `nf_conntrack_allow_invalid` (Boolean)
- `nftables` (Boolean)
- `nosmurfs` (Boolean)
- `protection_synflood` (Boolean)
- `smurf_log_level` (String)
- `tcp_flags_log_level` (String)
- `tcpflags` (String)
